separationModel.principle: Event Finality is strictly decoupled from Market Finality. A historical micro-market may reach PROVEN_FINAL state while the event remains LIVE or STALE, provided immutable snapshot evidence proves the outcome.

MICRO_MARKETS.evidenceSource: Immutable PostgreSQL snapshot tables (match_over_snapshots, match_dismissal_snapshots, match_ball_events)

MACRO_MARKETS.evidenceSource: Authoritative match finality or complete innings scorecard
